The evidence provided in the text is of very low quality and low relevance to the claim that a vegan diet leads to better heart health. The text explicitly states that the article relies "mostly on anecdotal evidence and personal testimonies" and lacks "empirical data or references." In scientific and medical contexts, anecdotal evidence is considered weak because it is subject to bias, lacks control groups, and cannot establish causality. The absence of empirical data or citations further undermines the credibility of the claim, making it impossible to verify the assertion based on the provided information.
